---
title: "Code_CognitivePaper"
output: html_document
date: "2026-05-18"
---

```{
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

df <- read_excel("Days-to-Criteria_FR1-RL_LernerLab.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1")

plot_df <- df %>%
  filter(Region == "full") %>%
  mutate(
    days = as.numeric(Days_to_Criteria_FR1),
    group = case_when(
      days <= 6 ~ "0-6",
      days <= 12 ~ "7-12",
      TRUE ~ "did not reach"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(Condition, group) %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()
}

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = group, y = percent, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percent)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(asyn = "red", CTL = "black")) +
  labs(x = "Days to criteria", y = "% mice", fill = "") +
  theme_classic()


```

## Including Plots

plot(pressure)
